# Clarín Awards__disambig_1

The Clarín Entertainment Awards () or simply the Clarín Awards () is an award program that has taken place in Argentina since 1998. Sponsored by the Argentine newspaper Clarín, the event honors Argentine achievements in entertainment, sports, literature, and advertising.
